source_title: Game Theory #27:  Putin Enters the Chat
summary: This episode extends Power As Alchemy, Strategy Material Test, and Nation As God-Machine by treating the dollar order as an addiction-maintenance system, sanctioned-state volatility as Putin's anti-dollar strategy, and military power as unable to float free from a national host.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Reserve privilege becomes free and easy money that America cannot voluntarily quit.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode directly grounds the public Power As Alchemy anchor for reserve privilege as addiction, including the domestic-default and foreign-coercion consequences.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Putin does not need to inherit the throne if sanctioned states can make the dollar-policing system unstable.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source supplies the public Strategy lens point's main example: pressure at several edges can raise the cost of American monetary policing without creating a harmonious replacement empire.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: An overseas military still needs a nation-state host when the home state breaks.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The closing answer directly supports the Nation page's host-state anchor: weapons, manufacturing, soldiers, financing, and theater control require a national body.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the May 21, 2026 lecture as the reserve-privilege addiction layer: after gold convertibility breaks, petrodollar demand and China's export role keep the dollar real, Chinese elites monetize power through dollar storage, and domestic default becomes impossible because bank money would be wiped out.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns the conversion of dollar demand into lived monetary reality. Strategy owns the theaters used to enforce that demand; Nation owns the state body that supplies military power.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use Putin's sanctioned-state strategy as a material test of monetary hegemony: Russia, North Korea, Iran, Belarus, Europe, and Japan matter insofar as they create volatility, split attention, strain alliances, and make American defense of dollar demand materially expensive.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the expenditure and theater-pressure audit. Game Theory owns player payoff, while Power As Alchemy owns the dollar reality being attacked.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add the imperial-collapse host-state rule: a military that seems global still comes from a nation-state's weapons, manufacturing, soldiers, and financing; if the home state collapses, overseas forces either retreat inward or seek new national hosts.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns the host-body rule. Strategy owns whether specific theaters can keep operating; Legitimacy Fiction owns any successor story that makes those hosts feel rightful.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: North Korea supplies a harsh energy/openness/cohesion recurrence: Jiang says poverty does not automatically win, but a poor society can be dangerous when it still has discipline, adaptation, and willingness to fight to the end.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Borderland owns the energy/open/cohesion scorecard; Strategy owns the Korean peninsula pressure created from that scorecard.

chronology_notes.note: The lecture marks 1971 as the break from gold-backed Bretton Woods into petrodollar and China-backed demand maintenance, with 2026 dollar addiction framed as a later consequence of that break.

On 2026-05-21 Jiang reads Putin's Beijing visit as present evidence of tactical China-Russia closeness, while also saying the partnership is unstable because Chinese elite dollar dependence and Chinese preference for American policing limit convergence with Russia.
The episode explicitly dates the Russia-North Korea mutual-defense pact to June 2024 and treats it as a recent strategic move inside Putin's campaign to create anti-dollar volatility.
Jiang gives 2029 as the point by which he expects German troops to be in Ukraine, making the Europe attrition scenario a dated forecast rather than a timeless warning.

next_actions.action: A later provenance-link pass can add episode mark links to the three existing lens points if the public read exposes matching marks with enough specificity.
Do not make a standalone de-dollarization page yet; current material routes cleanly to Power As Alchemy for monetary reality and Strategy for coercive enforcement.
